assessment: Zou et al., demonstrate that activation of the TRPV4 ion channel is a novel contributor to cardiac hypertrophy, adding to the number of mechanisms known to trigger pathological left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH), While the exact signaling pathway downstream of TRPV4 leading to pathological hypertrophy still remain to be uncovered, the findings that this ion channel contributes to cardiac hypertrophy and that the Piezo1 channel acts upstream of PLA2 and TRPV4 add to our understanding of the pathogenesis of LVH and heart failure.
